guarantees.claim: reg_fifo_wentry.data is always driven by conv_endian32(reg_fifo_wdata, 1'b1)
reg_fifo_wentry.mask is always assigned the concatenation of reg_fifo_wmask bits 0, 8, 16, 24
fifo_empty is always the logical negation of fifo_rvalid
fifo_wvalid is assigned hmac_fifo_wvalid when hmac_fifo_wsel and fifo_wready are both true; otherwise it is assigned reg_fifo_wvalid
unused_signals is always the XOR reduction of reg_fifo_wmask bits 7:1, 15:9, 23:17, 31:25

assumptions.claim: conv_endian32 function performs the correct byte‑order conversion expected by the downstream FIFO entry
assumptions.cond: whenever a word is written into the FIFO
assumptions.risk: incorrect data endianness leads to corrupted HMAC message buffer

assumptions.claim: fifo_rvalid accurately reflects whether the FIFO has valid data available on the read side
assumptions.risk: fifo_empty inversion could cause logic to read an empty FIFO or miss available data

assumptions.claim: When hmac_fifo_wsel is asserted and fifo_wready is high, hmac_fifo_wvalid is a valid write request and fifo_wready correctly indicates the FIFO can accept a write
assumptions.risk: mux selects an invalid or mis‑timed write valid, causing dropped or spurious writes into the message FIFO

assumptions.claim: Bits [7:1], [15:9], [23:17], [31:25] of reg_fifo_wmask are expected to be zero or functionally irrelevant; no error is flagged if they are non‑zero
assumptions.risk: invalid byte‑enable bits go undetected and may indicate a corrupted mask without any error containment

assumptions.claim: reg_fifo_wmask bits 0, 8, 16, 24 correctly represent byte‑level write enables for the corresponding 32‑bit data word
assumptions.risk: incorrect byte enables cause partial‑word corruption inside the FIFO entry

uncertain_points.claim: unused_signals may be computed solely to silence lint warnings and may not be connected downstream; if it is truly dead, it serves no functional purpose
uncertain_points.risk: dead code adds no value; if the signal is intended for error detection, the mechanism is missing

uncertain_points.claim: Mask bits [7:1],[15:9],[23:17],[31:25] are not used in the functional mask and have no error detection; a fault setting these bits would go undetected
uncertain_points.cond: if the design intent requires those bits to be zero
uncertain_points.risk: silent data‑mask corruption could occur without triggering any integrity check

uncertain_points.claim: conv_endian32 implementation is not defined in this chunk; its correctness and endianness convention must be verified in the full module context
uncertain_points.risk: an incorrect byte‑swap could compromise the entire HMAC computation
